repair.title: Acid Rain Was Reduced
repair.summary: From 1995 to 2023, annual sulfur dioxide emissions from U.S. power plants fell by 95 percent.
repair.why_it_matters: A major pollution problem was reduced through enforceable rules, monitoring, and cleaner technology.
repair.caveat: This is a U.S. example, and power-sector progress does not fix all air pollution.
